desc: Pillsbury Boston Cream Flavored Toaster Donut Pastries put a delicious spin on an iconic morning treat! Inspired by Boston cream donuts, they're a convenient and sweet part of any breakfast. Here's the icing on top: Every warm bite brings an irresistible combination of donut texture, creamy filling, and chocolatey icing that hits the spot. Toaster Donut Pastries make a great-tasting frozen addition to breakfast for even your busiest days. Keep these toaster pastries in the freezer until you're ready to pop 'em into the toaster or air fryer. Then follow the simple steps on the package to heat, add icing, and enjoy. Ready in minutes, reach for a frozen pastry for a quick bite on the way to work or school, without the fuss. At Pillsbury, we strive to make homemade moments extra special through our products and recipes, which help make cooking and baking easy, affordable, and convenient for even the busiest families. Contains six toaster pastries, with three servings in every box.
features: The Pillsbury™ Toaster Donut, Boston Cream offers a delicious and convenient way to enjoy a classic donut flavor without the need to visit a bakery. Each toaster donut features a soft, golden pastry filled with rich Boston cream and topped with a smooth chocolatey icing, delivering a perfect balance of flavor in every bite. Ready straight from the toaster or microwave, it’s an easy and mess-free breakfast or snack option. Whether you're starting your day or grabbing a quick treat, these donuts are individually wrapped for freshness and portion control, making them ideal for both home and on-the-go enjoyment.
